title: 飛機高升力裝置設計概念
summary: 以襟翼與前緣裝置的原創示意比較高升力構型，分清升力收益、阻力代價、致動負載和構型驗證；沒有實際起降操作設定。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Compare original flap/leading-edge-device sketches to separate lift benefit, drag cost, actuation load and configuration verification, without takeoff or landing settings. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 構型改變的升力係數：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Lift coefficient after configuration changes: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 構型改變的升力係數 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Lift coefficient after configuration changes and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 升力由動壓、參考翼面積與升力係數相乘；係數含翼型、迎角、雷諾數及壓縮性條件。
steps.instructionEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非飛機高升力裝置設計概念實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，S=2 m²，CL=0.6。式 L=ρV²SCL/2，基準結果 648 N。適用條件：低速固定CL模型，未描述失速或三維分離。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aircraft high-lift device concepts: rho=1.2 kg/m³, V=30 m/s, S=2 m² and CL=0.6. Formula L=ρV²SCL/2 gives 648 N. Conditions: Low-speed fixed-CL model, excluding stall and three-dimensional separation.
steps.failure: 使用濕面積取代參考翼面積會使係數不可比；分離後不能保持線性CL。
steps.failureEn: Using wetted area instead of reference wing area breaks coefficient comparisons; CL cannot remain linear after separation.
steps.check: 扣除支架皮重，以同一面積正規化力天平讀值，分別記錄迎角上掃與下掃。
steps.checkEn: Subtract support tare, normalize balance forces with one area definition, and record increasing and decreasing incidence separately.

knowledge.title: 構型改變的升力係數
knowledge.text: 升力由動壓、參考翼面積與升力係數相乘；係數含翼型、迎角、雷諾數及壓縮性條件。
knowledge.textEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把CL改成0.8；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 648 改為 864 N。在算式區重算並記下對「構型改變的升力係數」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only CL to 0.8, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 648 to 864 N. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Lift coefficient after configuration changes, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
升力係數在任意迎角都固定。
optionsEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Lift coefficient is constant at every angle of attack.

steps.title: 縫隙附近壓力分布：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pressure distribution near a slot: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 縫隙附近壓力分布 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pressure distribution near a slot and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 壓力係數將局部壓力相對自由流正規化；上下表面的壓力差分布積分後才構成截面力。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure coefficient normalizes local pressure relative to the free stream; sectional force follows integration of upper/lower pressure differences.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非飛機高升力裝置設計概念實際性能或製程：p−p∞=−300 Pa，q∞=500 Pa。式 Cp=(p−p∞)/q∞，基準結果 -0.6 dimensionless。適用條件：同一參考靜壓與動壓，單點Cp不能代表全翼升力。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aircraft high-lift device concepts: p-p_infinity=-300 Pa and q_infinity=500 Pa. Formula Cp=(p−p∞)/q∞ gives -0.6 dimensionless. Conditions: Common reference static/dynamic pressure; a single Cp point is not whole-wing lift.
steps.failure: 上下表面通道接反會把吸力峰的位置和方向解讀錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Swapped upper/lower channels misidentify the location and sign of the suction peak.
steps.check: 檢查壓孔阻塞與軟管標籤，沿弦向畫Cp曲線並保留積分步距。
steps.checkEn: Check blocked taps and tubing labels, plot chordwise Cp, and retain integration spacing.
